0022600213.text: The Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) are 13th in the West and 4th in the Pacific, 6.5 games back, while the Suns (3-6) are 12th in the West and 3rd in the Pacific, 5.5 games back, after losing their last game. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and the Clippers won the last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026, with no games yet between them in 2026-27. Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery) are out for the Clippers, and Cam Christie (ankle) is day-to-day, while Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery).
